summary: Defines a way for OSPFv2 and OSPFv3 routers to advertise optional capabilities to others in the routing domain using a new Router Information LSA. It can be flooded at link, area, or AS scope. It was replaced by RFC 7770.

eli5.summary: Routers hold up a card listing the special things they can do so other routers know what to ask of them. A newer RFC replaced this.

questions: how do ospf routers advertise capabilities
